name: selectable-table
title: Selectable table
description: Row selection for a table: a checkbox per row, a select-all header with a mixed state, Shift-click ranges, rows that say why they cannot be picked, and a live count.
docs: Give it columns, rows and getRowId, then hold the ids in a Set: selected and onSelectedChange. The header checkbox acts on the rows on screen and keeps ids that are not on screen, so a selection can span pages. Shift-click picks the range between two rows; return a sentence from isRowDisabled to say why a row cannot be picked (the box stays reachable by keyboard). Pass getRowLabel so each checkbox is named for its row. Pair it with SelectionBanner to offer every row across pages.
